name: Properties — overview
summary: Properties can be bought after the mission Nervous Ron (marked with a $ house icon). Businesses pay weekly into your bank account; others provide vehicle storage. Only 5 properties count for 100%. Some are protagonist-specific.

sections.title: When you can buy
sections.text: Three sources agree that purchasing properties becomes possible after completing Nervous Ron.

sections.title: Total cost
sections.text: GTABase states the total cost of buying every property is roughly $220,000,000. Exact per-property prices and income are only partly documented (see the individual property entries and the backlog).

name: Sonar Collections Dock
summary: A dock business that costs $250,000. Buying it unlocks the submarine and the underwater collectibles (submarine pieces and nuclear waste); GamePressure lists about $23,000 per barrel of nuclear waste and a $250,000 completion bonus.

sections.title: Price and returns
sections.text: Price $250,000 (GamePressure's unique-vehicle and nuclear-waste pages both give $250,000 for the Sonar Collections Dock.) Returns documented: ~$23,000 per nuclear-waste barrel and $250,000 for collecting all of them (single source, wording is approximate).

name: Towing Impound (Car Scrapyard)
summary: Franklin's property in South Los Santos: a towing/scrapyard business reported at $150,000, paying about $500 per vehicle towed. Price and income come from one aggregated source and are unverified.

sections.title: Reported figures
sections.text: A search aggregation reports $150,000 and $500 per tow; GamePressure lists the Car Scrapyard among property missions without prices.

name: Downtown Cab Co.
summary: Franklin's taxi business in East Vinewood; reported at $200,000 with about $2,000 per week. Figures are unverified (single aggregated source); GamePressure lists a Downtown Cab Co. property mission.

name: Tequi-la-la
summary: A nightclub property reported at $2,000,000 with weekly income. The figures come from a single aggregated source and are unverified; GamePressure lists a Tequi-la-la property mission.

name: Property missions (list)
summary: GamePressure documents property missions for: Pitchers, McKenzie Field Hangar, Car Scrapyard, Ten Cent Theater, Downtown Cab Co., Tivoli Theater, Doppler Cinema, Smoke on the Water, Tequi-la-la, Hookies and The Hen House. Prices, income and which protagonist can buy each are not documented there.
